site.name: FeyNote
footer.tagline: A free note-taking app for world-builders and tabletop RPG players.
landing.metaTitle: FeyNote - Free TTRPG & D&D Note-Taking App
landing.metaDescription: A free note-taking app for world-builders and tabletop RPG players. Embed statblocks and spells, collaborate on session notes, and organize your world with maps, calendars, and graph visualization.
landing.title: Notes built for the worlds you run
landing.subtitle: FeyNote is a free note-taking app for world-builders and tabletop RPG players. Embed statblocks and spells, collaborate on session notes in real time, and organize your world with maps, calendars, and a graph of everything you have written.
landing.sections.title: Everything your table needs
landing.sections.statblocks.title: Statblocks, Spells, and Items
landing.sections.statblocks.description: Your monsters, spells, and items live inside your notes. Create custom content, or tweak official content as you write.
landing.sections.statblocks.imageAlt: Statblocks embedded in a FeyNote document
landing.sections.references.title: Link Related Content
landing.sections.references.description: Reference related content and watch it update automatically as you edit. Keep track of storylines, NPCs, and important events.
landing.sections.collaboration.title: Sharing and Collaboration
landing.sections.collaboration.descripti: FeyNote is built for sharing from the ground up. Edit offline when you are away from an internet connection and your work syncs back up when you return, even in the browser.
landing.sections.calendars.title: Fantasy Calendars
landing.sections.calendars.description: Build a calendar that matches your world. Choose the number of months in a year, the number of days in each month, and the names of everything.
landing.sections.calendars.imageAlt: A custom fantasy calendar in FeyNote
landing.sections.graph.title: Graph and Tree Organization
landing.sections.graph.description: You do not have to choose between a graph and a tree. Build a hierarchy of high level topics and browse a web of interconnected content at the same time.
landing.sections.importer.title: Grab and Format Content Automatically
landing.sections.importer.description: Whether you play Dungeons and Dragons, OpenLegend, Starfinder, or another system, FeyNote makes creating monster blocks and items simple, and can pull content straight from a URL.
landing.sections.importer.imageAlt: The FeyNote assistant formatting imported content
landing.why.title: Why FeyNote
landing.why.free: Free to use, with no ads and no limit on how much you write.
landing.why.offline: Works offline on the web and on the desktop, then syncs when you reconnect.
landing.why.collaboration: Real-time collaboration with live cursors, built for the whole table.
landing.why.ttrpg: Purpose-built for tabletop content rather than adapted from a generic notes app.
landing.why.openSource: Open source, so you can read the code and contribute.
landing.why.yourData: Your notes export to JSON and Markdown whenever you want them.
landing.languages.title: Available in your language
landing.languages.description: FeyNote is translated by its community. Pick a language below, or help us add yours.
landing.closing.title: Start your next campaign in FeyNote
landing.closing.description: No account fees, no ads, and no limits on how much of your world you write down.
about.metaDescription: Meet Julian and Chris, the software engineers and TTRPG enthusiasts behind FeyNote. Learn about our mission to build the best free note-taking app for tabletop RPG players and world-builders.
about.title: About Us
about.lead: Thanks for taking the time to read about us.
about.intro: The short of it is that Chris and Julian are both software engineers at our day jobs, but we both spend a lot of time playing TTRPG games.
about.julian.title: Hi, I'm Julian
about.julian.1: I spend a lot of time working on open source things. At my day job I work for Mozilla on the accounts team. During my free time I'm either working on this app, or on RecipeSage, an open source recipe keeper.
about.julian.2: I've been playing TTRPG games since I was 11 in Boy Scouts, where we'd play on long bus rides or at camp. I have lots of great memories throughout the years, but my favorite is when the players in my campaign found an underground fighting ring where heroes were pit against beasts and monstrosities. My party took it upon themselves to free the captive animals, at the Druid's encouragement, and found a humongous giant crab deep within the place. Freeing this crab was quite a task, but they accomplished it using gaseous form, read: a crabby mist. It was quite the night, and to this day the party will occasionally chant in unison "crab, crab, crab".
about.chris.title: Hi, I'm Chris
about.chris.1: I'm a software engineer over at 2U, an edtech company, and in my free time you'll find me either writing, playing Helldivers with friends, or playing in one of my three campaigns.
about.chris.2: My characters include an extremist anti-colonialist druid, yes the antagonizer in freeing the captive animals mentioned above, a demon summoning wizard, and of course everyone needs a good necromancer. As you can tell, I tend to enjoy playing more eccentric characters, but worry not DMs of the world, I still manage to keep my average alignment neutral. I think. We've built this software for other TTRPG enthusiasts like us with the hope that it'll help bolster the tabletop community. TTRPGs are a great way to escape, build new connections, and have some laughs with friends. We hope this software can help connect you and whichever table you're a part of.

about.contact.github: Report a bug or request a feature on
pricing.metaDescription: Free TTRPG note-taking app with no ads or limits. Unlimited D&D notes, monster statblocks, and campaign organization. Optional pay-what-you-want contributions for extra features.
pricing.title: Always Free
pricing.subtitle: Every feature in FeyNote is free to use, with no ads and no limits on how much you write.
pricing.intro.1: All features within FeyNote are completely free to use, and it's our commitment for this platform to be an accessible place without any ads or limits on the amount of content you create.
pricing.intro.2: We do have some benefits for contributors, similar to a Patreon-style contributor model, but they only raise limits on things that are exceedingly costly for us to host, such as extra-large file uploads.
pricing.intro.3: All funds contributed go directly toward improving the platform and to our artists. We do not seek to make a profit from this app. If you find FeyNote useful, please consider supporting us.
pricing.free.title: Free
pricing.free.history: Document revision history, up to 10 revisions
pricing.contribute.title: Choose Your Price
pricing.contribute.description: Contribute whatever you'd like. This functionality is costly for us to host and is unlocked for contributors as a thank you.
pricing.contribute.history: More revision history, up to 25 revisions
features.metaDescription: D&D and TTRPG campaign management features: embed monster statblocks, real-time collaboration, offline editing, fantasy calendars, graph visualization, and import from Obsidian or Logseq.
features.title: Feature List
features.subtitle: FeyNote is early in its development and we're working hard to bring all of our ideas to the platform. Here are a few of our highlight features, as well as a few we hope to add soon.
features.core.title: Core Features
features.core.ttrpg.title: TTRPG Content
features.core.ttrpg.description: Embed your statblocks, spells, and items directly within your notes.
features.core.collaboration.title: Real-time Collaboration
features.core.collaboration.description: Share your document with others, and edit at the same time with live cursors.
features.core.offline.title: Offline First
features.core.offline.description: The entire site works offline, so you can edit your notes on the go.
features.core.themes.title: Themeable
features.core.themes.description: We've built several theming options so your content looks exactly like your source books.
features.core.panes.title: Paneable UI
features.core.panes.description: Have multiple documents open side-by-side or in multiple in-app tabs.
features.core.urls.title: Import URLs
features.core.urls.description: Paste a URL into FeyNote and your content will be pulled in and automatically formatted for your notes.
features.relationships.title: Relationships and References
features.relationships.tree.title: Tree
features.relationships.tree.description: Organize your content in a traditional hierarchy, if you like.
features.relationships.graph.title: Graph
features.relationships.graph.description: View your content as a connected graph of nodes, helpful for browsing or seeing relationships.
features.relationships.references.title: References
features.relationships.references.descri: Connect your notes by creating deep references to other documents. Text is automatically kept up to date as you edit.
features.relationships.previews.title: Previews
features.relationships.previews.descript: See outgoing and incoming references, or backlinks, between your documents.
features.text.title: Text
features.text.blocks.title: Block-Style Nesting
features.text.blocks.description: Organize your notes in bullet-journal style blocks, editing with hierarchy for summarized notes.
features.text.fonts.title: Rich Fonts
features.text.fonts.description: Choose from a myriad of different fonts to fit your theme.
features.calendars.title: Calendars
features.calendars.customization.title: Customization
features.calendars.customization.descrip: Create an entirely arbitrary date system and organize your notes by date in your world.
features.import.title: Supported Import Formats
features.import.obsidian.title: Obsidian
features.import.obsidian.description: Bring your existing Obsidian vault along with you.
features.import.logseq.title: Logseq
features.import.logseq.description: Bring your existing Logseq graph along with you.
features.import.url.title: URL
features.import.url.description: Automatically pull TTRPG content from a URL.
features.export.title: Supported Export Formats
features.export.json.title: JSON
features.export.json.description: Export your documents to JSON at any time.
features.export.markdown.title: Markdown
features.export.markdown.description: Export your documents to Markdown at any time.
features.upcoming.title: We're working hard on the following
features.upcoming.unlinked.title: Unlinked References
features.upcoming.unlinked.description: Automatic detection of content that is missing a reference, for example NPC names.
features.upcoming.googleDocs.title: Google Docs
features.upcoming.googleDocs.description: The ability to import downloads from Google Docs.
features.upcoming.themes.title: More Themes
features.upcoming.mobile.title: Mobile Apps
features.upcoming.mobile.description: The ability to install FeyNote on your phone or tablet as a native application.
